name: @glot/review
description: Live review: annotate translations directly on your site (pins, threads, AI rewording, realtime). Lazy-loaded, Shadow DOM, invisible to normal visitors.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/index.ts src/app.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outdir=dist && esbuild src/global.ts --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/review.global.js && esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=glotReviewApp --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/review.app.global.js && tsc
